en: Black-and-white postcard showing a curved coastal road running along a wooded hillside beside the sea. Small waves break onto the shore; a few scattered buildings appear along the road and on a small headland. At the far left, higher on the hill, is a compact cluster of buildings resembling a fortified town or castle. Greek text captions are printed in the white border beneath the image, and a website watermark (elia.org.gr) appears across the lower right of the image.
